title: wtctl status --json
description: Remove order steps 1 to 6 (worktree) or the in-use check (throwaway), running every check it can. Nothing changed except the mirror refresh. remove --dry-run prints this object plus dry_run: true (remove.json).

would_remove.description: What remove with the same flags, run by a human, would do: true, false (reason says why), or null when no refusal was found but the outcome could not be determined (the fetch failed; reason null).

reason.description: The refusal remove would give (first by precedence), or null.

human_required.description: true: remove is a human-only command for this record (adopted, or a partial worktree); without a human actor it exits 13.

force_overrides.description: The failed checks a human --force would override.

head.description: The worktree's current HEAD; null for throwaways or when it could not be read (integrity failed).

current_branch.description: Untrusted: the worktree's current branch, read from files agents can write; null when detached, for throwaways, or when it could not be read.
